title: Wells Fargo Enterprise Onboarding Platform
overview: The Enterprise Onboarding Platform is an internal banking application developed for Wells Fargo to simplify and automate customer onboarding and document management processes.

The application enables relationship managers and operations teams to onboard customers, upload and verify KYC documents, manage document workflows, and track onboarding status through a secure, scalable, and user-friendly interface.

The application is developed using React.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, REST APIs, and Micro Frontend Architecture, allowing multiple teams to independently develop and deploy different business modules.

businessFlow.title: Customer Search
businessFlow.description: Search existing customers using Customer ID, Business Name, Account Number, or Tax ID.

businessFlow.title: Create Onboarding
businessFlow.description: Relationship managers create new onboarding requests by filling customer and business information.

businessFlow.title: Document Upload
businessFlow.description: Upload multiple KYC and business documents with validation, preview, delete, replace, and progress tracking.

businessFlow.title: Verification
businessFlow.description: Documents are validated and verified before moving to the approval workflow.

businessFlow.title: Approval Workflow
businessFlow.description: Business users review applications, approve or reject requests, and provide comments.

businessFlow.title: Customer Onboarded
businessFlow.description: Once approved, the customer onboarding process is completed and the application status is updated.

title: HDFC MyCards Portal
overview: HDFC MyCards is a digital banking platform that allows customers to manage their Credit Cards, Debit Cards and card-related services from a single web application.

The portal provides features like card summary, transaction history, reward points, statement download, authentication, profile management, card controls and multiple banking services through a secure user experience.
Worked as a React Developer at Reward360 where multiple enterprise banking modules were developed using React.js, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, REST APIs and reusable UI components.

businessFlow.title: Login
businessFlow.description: Customer enters registered mobile number and verifies using OTP authentication.

businessFlow.title: Dashboard
businessFlow.description: Displays credit limit, outstanding balance, due date, reward points and recent activities.

businessFlow.title: Card Management
businessFlow.description: View card details, enable or disable online transactions, manage limits and control card usage.

businessFlow.title: Transactions
businessFlow.description: View recent transactions, filter records, download statements and check payment history.

businessFlow.title: Reward Points
businessFlow.description: View accumulated reward points, eligible rewards and redemption options.

businessFlow.title: Profile Management
businessFlow.description: Update profile, contact details, communication preferences and card settings.
